back.en: Intersection — elements in both A and B
back.bm: Persilangan — unsur dalam A dan B

back.en: Union — elements in A or B or both
back.bm: Kesatuan — unsur dalam A atau B atau kedua-duanya

back.en: Outside both A and B: n(ξ) − n(A ∪ B)
back.bm: Di luar A dan B: n(ξ) − n(A ∪ B)

back.en: Work out brackets first, e.g. (A ∪ B) ∩ C
back.bm: Selesaikan kurungan dahulu, cth. (A ∪ B) ∩ C

back.en: Fill the overlap first, then 'only' regions, then the outside
back.bm: Isi bahagian bertindih dahulu, kemudian rantau 'sahaja', kemudian bahagian luar

back.en: A ∩ B = A and A ∪ B = B
back.bm: A ∩ B = A dan A ∪ B = B

back.en: (A ∩ B)′: all but the overlap. A′ ∩ B′: only outside both circles
back.bm: (A ∩ B)′: semua kecuali bertindih. A′ ∩ B′: hanya di luar kedua-dua bulatan
